Bettina, I can't set up a recurring Monday 08:00 post. I don't have a scheduling tool here, so nothing is booked and nothing will post automatically next Monday.

What I can do:
- **Post the digest on request.** Ask me in #coastal-team on a Monday and I'll post the "Coastal week ahead" summary from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, covering last week's activity and open customer items. I'll only use what the channel's members can already see.
- **Get the recurring version set up.** Someone with scheduling access on the workspace can create it, or your admin can enable it on my side. Once it exists, I'll follow the same rules for what goes into each post.
